repomix.user_provided_header: Phases 7 and 8: Cart, Orders & Allocation, Shipping, Payments, Webhooks & Promotions. Includes complete migrations (including refund flags, hot FK indexes, widened columns, unique customer cart, branch cities, system user), models, services (including ShippingQuoteService), controllers, requests, resources, routing, factories, permission seeders, prune commands, regression review tests, and configurations for guest and logged-in cart/checkout, automatic branch allocation with stock reservations, order state machine and histories, shipping companies/zones/rates/shipments, promotions and coupons with usage limits and discount calculations, and signed HMAC webhooks for payment gateways and shipping carriers with idempotency logs.
